purpose: Screen H2 for one fixed 6mm rigid cable-like obstacle at 0.4m/s. Not H1/H3 or sim-to-real.

randomization.algorithm: Python random.Random; four rounds, paired adjacent arms; opposite first arms across seeds per round and two AB/two BA per seed

block_interpretation: New seed labels 77500/77501 on the SAME fixed geometry, not two independent obstacle scenarios or identical-state branches

fixed.obstacle: rigid capsule, diameter6mm, cylindrical section4m, x3.1m, yaw+8deg
fixed.note: Inherited config/metadata contain legacy radius/mesh tags. Preserve bytes; effective collision is verified SDF. PPO/reward fields are inert in this baseline evaluation.

initialization.command_ownership: one inline evaluation governor; no second ROS speed governor

outcome_windows.primary: first recorded positive-obstacle manifold +0.05s to +3.0s; fixed for both arms; not guaranteed to remove entire first-impact tail
outcome_windows.whole_route: unchanged first control input through final action end
outcome_windows.recovery: existing concurrent CRUISE scale>=0.98, executed v>=0.392m/s, body v>=0.95 precontact median sustained0.3s after contact end
outcome_windows.negative_control: precontact approach and first50ms only when every GT/joint interpolation support precedes the first reduced executed command; otherwise mark contaminated/unavailable, never use it as a causal negative control

measurement.native: Keep replay and native scores unchanged, separate namespace
measurement.vertical: Unfiltered original IMU header-time samples; sample RMS and peak; raw values retained; existing signal_stats coverage>=0.98
measurement.slip: gt_timestamp_series + integrate at original GT stamps; interpolate joints only, maxgap10.001ms, no extrapolation; same ratio clipping/denominator; slip_square_per_m units s/m, not joules
measurement.sensitivity: Retain original-GT slip plus existing20ms grid and+10ms shifted grid on same windows. Require same direction for primary slip effect; report all. No downsampling IMU to10Hz for scoring, no favorable grid selection.
measurement.protection: No spike removal, no zero imputation, no changes to historical studies/models or parameter configuration

causal_scope.before_contact: All commands/governor events and approach pose/speed reported. Any precontact reduced command or failed predeclared approach caliper prevents a clean postcontact-H2 pass; retain attempt, do not exclude/replace.
causal_scope.authority: Report detector time, first reduced final executed command and wheel target, body/encoder response, and next loaded-contact times. H2 cannot pass without intervention preceding at least one subsequent loaded contact in each reactive episode; magnitude benefit requires randomized arm comparison, not a body-speed dip alone.
causal_scope.same_time_reference_not_in_budget: This two-arm screen only establishes local H2 including the cost of slowdown. No advantage beyond driving slower, tuned-reactive H3, generalization or factory readiness claim.

analysis.unit: episode, not frames/contact points; eight chronological random-order pairs nested in two fixed seed blocks
analysis.estimand: For metric M, block benefit=1-mean(M_reactive,4)/mean(M_full,4); aggregate benefit=equal-weight mean of the two block benefits. Undefined PI denominator -> unavailable/inconclusive, no epsilon rescue.
analysis.timing: equal-block mean of paired governor-minus-PI route seconds; report every pair and each block
analysis.uncertainty: Prespecified paired bootstrap within each fixed seed: resample four intact pairs with replacement in each block,10000 replicates, rng20261018; percentile95% interval. No frame bootstrap or population-of-terrains inference; tiny-n coverage not guaranteed.
analysis.failures: Count all16 assigned positions and all attempted outcomes. Any unsuccessful physical arrival/stop means no promotion. Missing/censored quality remains null and denominators reported; no success-only aggregate used for decision.
analysis.early_stopping: No early benefit/futility check; hard-stop on readiness/timestamp/provenance/measurement integrity, rollover or invalid physical state; no retry/replacement. Ordinary timeout/stall/arrival miss retained and subsequent slots may proceed if infrastructure/physical validity intact. Early stop -> incomplete, never pass.
analysis.historical_data: 77400/77401 and earlier trials are diagnostics only; no pooling into confirmation totals or selecting thresholds from outcomes

pass_requirements: all16 attempts complete, all8 arrivals/controller with2s stable stop, reporting/provenance/approach gates pass
executed intervention has timing opportunity before subsequent loaded contact in every reactive episode
both block primary improvements>=application minimum; aggregate primary lower95% bootstrap bound>=same minimum
other postcontact quality metric and whole-route vibration/slip point estimates do not worsen in either block; complete-sequence primary benefit has same direction
mean governor time<=18.5s and<=1.05xPI, mean physical path RMSE<=1.05xPI, each block; aggregate upper95% interval of added route seconds<=application allowed added seconds
predeclared slip sensitivity does not reverse the direction of the selected primary slip conclusion
decision.pass_next: Review a small classical governor tuning budget on separate development seeds; no automatic execution or predictor/PPO release
decision.not_pass: Stop this frozen intervention configuration/small-screen branch; distinguish observed harm from inconclusive uncertainty. No automatic extra episodes, delay search, penalty change or claim that H2 is globally false.

prerequisites: application primary metric/minimum worthwhile improvement/allowed extra seconds and origin confirmed
seal application file hash and protocol/references/order manifest before first attempt
review/release max16 attempt budget explicitly; no implied release from completing the form
implement/review a separate bounded executor preserving ordinary failures; existing four-attempt PI runner must not be reused as-is
verify actual spawned world/robot and effective arm configuration hashes at launch
